adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts the refactor from a single calendar reference to multiple references introduces a loop over bookingCalendarReference (filter). Inside that loop, when a credential isn’t found in bookingToDelete.user.credentials, it performs an awaited prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } }) and then awaits getCalendar(calendarCredential). This can cause an N+1 pattern (one DB query per reference) and sequential latency because the DB fetch and calendar construction happen inside the per-reference loop rather than being batched or prefetched. This is a performance/architecture concern grounded in the diff, not a correctness bug.
